notes: verdicts describe the RESOLVED backends (contiguous vs paged), not the requested selections (contiguous vs paged).

this harness calls EngineV2Factory.makeProductionBuild directly and so bypasses the slot-routing policy (EngineV2KVBackendPolicy.applySlotVetoes, applied by EngineV2SlotFactory). Every verdict here is a BACKEND result, not a statement about how production routes a slot to that backend.
token comparisons are over RAW SAMPLED TOKEN IDS with temperature 0; text equality is a strictly weaker oracle and is not used.

both backend arms use native KV precision and the factory's observed per-layer storage types; ambient dtype overrides are cleared. The paged arm reports mixed storage (mixed means multiple native layer types). The separate fp32 diagnostic may be UNAVAILABLE when the native dtype guard refuses its override; it never coerces KV or proves packed precision quality.
